items.stem: How is neem useful to farmers?
items.answer: Neem is useful to farmers as the seeds of the neem tree are powdered and mixed with water and sprayed on the crops, to drive away the termites, insects, and locusts. It also helps in controlling breeding of the mosquitoes.

items.stem: Mention some of the uses of the neem tree.
items.answer: Neem tree furniture cannot be attacked by termites. Clothes and grains in storage are safe with neem leaves. It purifies the air. People clean teeth with twigs of Neem tree. All its parts are used to make medicines. Leaves also protect the stored grains.

items.stem: Why can Neem Baba not remember the year when he was born?
items.answer: Neem Baba does not remember his age as millions of years have passed since he was born.

items.stem: Which parts of the neem tree are used to make medicines?
items.answer: All parts of the neem tree are used for making medicine.
